short.es: Debut country-pop que presentó la narrativa íntima y diarista que marcaría su carrera.
short.en: A country-pop debut that introduced the diaristic, intimate storytelling that would define her career.

extended.es: Su primer álbum combina raíces country con pop juvenil y letras centradas en la adolescencia: enamoramientos, desilusiones y la búsqueda de identidad. La composición, directa y conversacional, establece el tono de su estilo narrativo y su enfoque en detalles cotidianos como motor emocional.
extended.en: Her first album blends country roots with youthful pop sensibilities and lyrics focused on teenage crushes, heartbreak, and self-discovery. The writing’s direct, conversational tone lays the foundation for her detail-driven narrative style.

tracks.title: Tim McGraw
tracks.lyrics:
He said the way my blue eyes shined
Put those **Georgia stars to shame that night**
I said, "That's a lie"
Just a boy in a Chevy truck
That had a tendency of **getting stuck on backroads at night**
And I was right there beside him all summer long
And then the time we woke up to find that summer gone
But **when you think Tim McGraw**
I hope you think my favorite song
The one we danced to all night long
The moon like a spotlight on the lake
When you think happiness
I hope you think **that little black dress**
I hope you think I'm the girl who used to rock you
Kind of blue in a **faded blue jean girl**

tracks.title: Picture to Burn
tracks.lyrics:
State the obvious, I didn't get my perfect fantasy
I realize you love yourself more than you could ever love me
So **go and tell your friends that I'm obsessive and crazy**
That's fine, I'll tell mine you're gay
And by the way... I hate that **stupid old pickup truck** you never let me drive
You're a **redneck heartbreak** who's really bad at lying
So watch me strike a match on all my wasted time
As far as I'm concerned, you're **just another picture to burn**

tracks.title: Teardrops on My Guitar
tracks.lyrics:
Drew looks at me, I fake a smile so he won't see
That I want and I'm needing everything that we should be
I'll bet she's beautiful, **that girl he talks about**
And she's got everything that I have to live without
Drew talks to me, I laugh 'cause it's so damn funny
That I can't even see anyone else but him
He's the **reason for the teardrops on my guitar**
The only thing that keeps me wishing on a wishing star
He's the song in the car **I keep singing, don't know why I do**

tracks.title: A Place in This World
tracks.lyrics:
I don't know what I want, so don't ask me
Cause I'm still trying to figure it out
Don't know what's down this road, I'm just walking
**Trying to see through the rain coming down**
Even though I'm not the only one who feels the way I do
I'm alone, on my own, and that's all I know
I'll be strong, I'll be wrong, oh but life goes on
**I'm just a girl trying to find a place in this world**

tracks.title: Cold as You
tracks.lyrics:
You have a way of coming easily to me
And when you take, you take the very best of me
So I start a fight 'cause I need to feel something
And you do what you want 'cause I'm not what you wanted
Oh, what a shame, **what a rainy ending given to a perfect day**
So I smile and say, "You got what you deserved"
And **you come away with a great little story**
Of a mess of a dreamer with the nerve to adore you
And I've never been anywhere **cold as you**

tracks.title: The Outside
tracks.lyrics:
I didn't know what I would find
When I went looking for a reason, I know I didn't read between the lines
And, baby, I've got nowhere to go
I tried to take the road less traveled by
But **I'm double-crossed by a bare-faced lie**
And I've learned that you're only gonna believe what you want to
**You've been looking at me from the outside**
And you're never gonna know what I'm like inside

tracks.title: Tied Together with a Smile
tracks.lyrics:
Seems the only one who doesn't see your beauty
Is the face in the mirror looking back at you
You walk around here thinking you're not good enough
But he's **stopped by and held by the snare in your eyes**
And you're **tied together with a smile**
But you're coming undone
Goodbye, baby, with a smile, baby, baby
**You're tied together with a smile but you're coming undone**

tracks.title: Stay Beautiful
tracks.lyrics:
Cory's eyes are like a jungle, he smiles, it's like the radio
He whispers songs into my window in words that nobody knows
There's no time for lookin' back, I'm just tryin' to see your face
**You're beautiful, every little piece, love**
And don't you know **you're really gonna be someone**
Ask anyone, and if you're ever lucky enough to be her one
Say your prayers to the stars and **stay beautiful**

tracks.title: Should've Said No
tracks.lyrics:
It's strange to think the songs we used to sing
The smiles, the flowers, everything is gone
Yesterday I found out about you
Even now just looking at you feels so wrong
You should've said no, you should've gone home
**You should've thought twice 'fore you let it all go**
You should've known that word, with what you did with her
**Would get back to me**
And I should've been there in the back of your mind
**I shouldn't be asking myself, "Why?"**

tracks.title: Mary's Song (Oh My My My)
tracks.lyrics:
She said, I was seven and you were nine
I looked at you like the stars that shined
In the sky, **the pretty lights**
And our daddies used to joke about the two of us
**Growing up and falling in love**
And our mamas smiled and rolled their eyes
And said, "**Oh my, my, my**"
Take me back to the creek beds we turned into castles
Take me back to the time when we walked down the aisle

tracks.title: Our Song
tracks.lyrics:
I was riding shotgun with my hair undone
In the front seat of his car
He's got a one-hand feel on the steering wheel
The other on my heart
I looked around, turned the radio down
I said, "Baby, is something wrong?"
I say, "**Our song is the slamming screen door**
Sneaking out late, tapping on your window
When we're on the phone and you talk real low
**'Cause you're late and your mama don't know**"
Our song is the way you laugh

short.es: Consolidación country-pop con himnos románticos y un salto masivo a la popularidad global.
short.en: A breakthrough country-pop record packed with romantic anthems and a major leap into global stardom.

extended.es: Con un sonido más pulido y ganchos pop, el disco amplía su paleta emocional: ilusión, vulnerabilidad y euforia. Mantiene el corazón country, pero con ambición de crossover; las melodías y los relatos hacen del álbum un punto de inflexión en su proyección mainstream.
extended.en: With a more polished sound and pop hooks, the album expands her emotional range—hope, vulnerability, and exhilaration—while keeping its country core. Its crossover ambition and vivid storytelling made it a defining turning point.

tracks.title: Fearless (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
There's something 'bout the way the street looks when it's just rained
There's a **glow off the pavement**, you walk me to the car
And you know I wanna ask you to dance around and around
'Cause I don't know how it gets better than this
You take my hand and drag me headfirst
**Fearless**
And I don't know why, but **with you I'd dance in a storm**
In my best dress, fearless

tracks.title: Fifteen (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
You take a deep breath and you walk through the doors
It's the morning of your very first day
**You say hi to your friends you ain't seen in a while**
Try and stay out of everybody's way
'Cause when you're fifteen and somebody tells you they love you
**You're gonna believe them**
And Abigail gave everything she had to a boy who changed his mind
And **we both cried**

tracks.title: Love Story (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
We were both young when I first saw you
I close my eyes and the flashback starts
I'm standing there on a **balcony in summer air**
See the lights, see the party, the ball gowns
See you make your way through the crowd
And say, "Hello"
Little did I know... That you were Romeo, you were throwing pebbles
And my daddy said, "**Stay away from Juliet**"
And I was crying on the staircase, **begging you, "Please, don't go"**

tracks.title: Hey Stephen (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
Hey Stephen, I know looks can be deceiving
But I know I saw a light in you
And **as we walked we were talking**
I didn't say half the things I wanted to
Of all those girls tossing rocks at your window
**I'll be the one waiting there even when it's cold**
Hey Stephen, boy, you might have me believing
I don't always have to be alone

tracks.title: White Horse (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
Say you're sorry, that face of an angel
Comes out just when you need it to
As I paced back and forth all this time
**'Cause I honestly believed in you**
Holding on, the days drag on
Stupid girl, **I should've known, I should've known**
That I'm not a princess, this ain't a fairy tale
I'm not the one you'll sweep off her feet
Lead her up the stairwell
**This ain't Hollywood, this is a small town**

tracks.title: You Belong With Me (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
You're on the phone with your girlfriend, she's upset
She's going off about something that you said
'Cause **she doesn't get your humor like I do**
I'm in my room, it's a typical Tuesday night
I'm listening to the kind of music she doesn't like
And she'll never know your story like I do
**But she wears short skirts, I wear T-shirts**
She's Cheer Captain and I'm on the bleachers
Dreaming about the day when you wake up and find
That **what you're looking for has been here the whole time**

tracks.title: Breathe (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
I see your face in my mind as I drive away
'Cause **none of us thought it was gonna end that way**
People are people and sometimes we change our minds
But it's killing me to see you go after all this time
**And I can't breathe without you, but I have to**
Losing a visibility, oh, I kept you in my sights
What am I supposed to do when I'm checking my watch
And I **haven't seen you in a while?**

tracks.title: Tell Me Why (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
I took a chance, I took a shot
And you might think I'm bulletproof, but I'm not
**You took a swing, I took it hard**
And up here from the ground, I see who you are
I'm sick and tired of your attitude
I'm feeling like I don't know you
**You tell me that you love me, then you cut me down**
And I need you like a heartbeat
But you know you got a mean streak
**Tell me why**

tracks.title: You're Not Sorry (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
All this time I was wasting, hoping you would come around
I've been giving out chances every time and all you do is let me down
And **it's taking me a long time**
But I've figured you out
And you can tell me that you're sorry
But I don't believe you, baby, like I did before
**You're not sorry, no, no, oh**
Looking so innocent, **I might believe you if I didn't know**

tracks.title: The Way I Loved You (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
He is sensible and so incredible
And all my single friends are jealous
He says everything I need to hear and it's like **I couldn't ask for anything better**
But I miss screaming and fighting and kissing in the rain
And it's 2 AM and **I'm cursing your name**
You're so wild and crazy, just so frustrating
Intoxicating, complicated
**Got away just at the perfect time**

tracks.title: Forever & Always (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
Once upon a time, I believe it was a Tuesday when I caught your eye
And we caught onto something, I hold onto the night
**You looked me in the eye and told me you loved me**
Were you just kidding? 'Cause it seems to me
This thing is breaking down, **we almost never even talk**
I don't know what I did, but I'll take the blame
And I stare at the phone, he still hasn't called
**And then you feel so low you can't feel nothing at all**

short.es: Álbum escrito íntegramente por ella: confesional, dramático y con más rock en la producción.
short.en: Entirely self-written: confessional, dramatic, and leaning further into rock-tinged production.

extended.es: Construido como una colección de cosas no dichas, equilibra baladas intensas con temas de energía pop-rock. La autoría total refuerza su identidad como narradora, y el disco marca una expansión sonora: guitarras más presentes, arreglos amplios y un dramatismo más adulto.
extended.en: Framed as a set of things left unsaid, it balances intense ballads with punchier pop-rock moments. Its sole authorship underscores her identity as a storyteller while the sound grows bigger—more guitars, broader arrangements, and a more mature dramatic arc.

tracks.title: Mine (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
You were in college, working part-time, waiting tables
Left a small town, never looked back
I was a flight risk, with a fear of fallin'
**Wondering why we bother with love, if it never lasts**
You made a rebel a careless man's careful daughter
You are **the best thing that's ever been mine**
And I remember that fight, 2:30 AM
As everything was slipping out of my hands
**I ran out, crying, and you followed me out into the street**

tracks.title: Sparks Fly (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
The way you move is like a full-on rainstorm
And I'm a house of cards
**You're the kind of reckless that should send me runnin'**
But I kinda like it
And I see no remedy for memory, your face is like a melody
It won't leave my head
**Drop everything now, meet me in the pouring rain**
Kiss me on the sidewalk, take away the pain
'Cause I see **sparks fly whenever you smile**

tracks.title: Back to December (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
I'm so glad you made time to see me
How's life? Tell me, how's your family?
I haven't seen them in a while
You gave me roses and I left them there to die
So **this is me swallowing my pride**
Standing in front of you saying, "I'm sorry for that night"
And **I go back to December all the time**
It turns out freedom ain't nothing but missing you
**Wishing I'd realized what I had when you were mine**

tracks.title: Speak Now (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
I am not the kind of girl
Who should be rudely barging in on a white veil occasion
But you are not the kind of boy
Who should be marrying the wrong girl
**Don't say "yes", run away now**
I'll meet you when you're out of the church at the back door
**I hear the preacher say, "Speak now or forever hold your peace"**
And I stand up with shaky hands, all eyes on me
**Horrified looks from everyone in the room**

tracks.title: Dear John (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
Long were the nights when my days once revolved around you
Counting my footsteps, praying the floor won't fall through, again
**My mother accused me of losing my mind**
But I swore I was fine
**Don't you think nineteen's too young**
To be played by your dark, twisted games when I loved you so?
I should've known
**You are an expert at sorry and keeping lines blurry**
Never impressed by me acing your tests

tracks.title: Mean (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
You, with your words like knives and swords and weapons that you use against me
You have knocked me off my feet again got me feeling like I'm nothing
**You, with your voice like nails on a chalkboard**
Calling me out when I'm wounded
**Someday I'll be living in a big old city**
And all you're ever gonna be is mean
**And I can see you years from now in a bar**
Talking over a football game with that same big loud opinion

tracks.title: The Story of Us (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
I used to know my place was the spot next to you
Now I'm searching the room for an empty seat
**Attempting to explain a mind-blowing miscommunication**
How did we get here?
**I'm dying to know, is it killing you like it's killing me?**
I don't know what to say since the twist of fate
When it all broke down and **the story of us looks a lot like a tragedy now**
Next chapter.

tracks.title: Never Grow Up (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
Your little hand's wrapped around my finger
And it's so quiet in the world tonight
**Your little eyelids flutter cause you're dreaming**
So I tuck you in, turn on your favorite night light
Oh, darling, **don't you ever grow up**
It could stay this simple
I won't let nobody hurt you, won't let no one break your heart
**And no one will desert you**
Just try to never grow up

tracks.title: Enchanted (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
Your eyes whispered, "Have we met?"
Across the room your silhouette starts to make its way to me
The playful conversation starts
**Counter all your quick remarks like passing notes in secrecy**
It was enchanting to meet you
**All I can say is, I was enchanted to meet you**
This night is sparkling, don't you let it go
I'm wonderstruck, blushing all the way home
**Please don't be in love with someone else**

tracks.title: Better Than Revenge (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
Now I'm an expert at the silence that comes with a letting go
I thought I knew the girl of my dreams
**She's not a saint and she's not what you think**
She's an actress, whoa
**She's better known for the things that she does on the mattress**
Wait, that's not it anymore...
**He was a moth to the flame, she was holding the matches**
There is nothing I do better than revenge

tracks.title: Innocent (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
I guess you really did it this time
Left yourself in your war path
Lost your balance on a tightrope
**Lost your mind tryin' to get it back**
It's okay, life is a tough crowd
32 and still growin' up now
**Who you are is not what you did**
You're still an innocent
**Time turns flames to embers, you'll have new Septembers**
Every one of us has messed up too

short.es: Ruptura y caos emocional en un álbum ecléctico que puentea country, pop y rock.
short.en: Heartbreak and emotional chaos in an eclectic bridge between country, pop, and rock.

extended.es: Con un concepto de “amor en technicolor”, el disco abraza contrastes: baladas acústicas, pop explosivo y guiños rock. Es un tránsito decisivo hacia el pop, pero sin soltar el pulso narrativo; su variedad estilística funciona como metáfora de una ruptura vivida con intensidad y contradicción.
extended.en: Built around the idea of love in technicolor, it embraces contrasts: acoustic ballads, explosive pop, and rock flourishes. It’s a decisive step toward pop without abandoning her narrative core—its stylistic variety mirrors the messiness of intense heartbreak.

tracks.title: State of Grace (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
I'm walking fast through the traffic lights
Busy streets and busy lives
And all we know is don't let go
**We are alone with our changing minds**
We fall in love till it hurts or bleeds or fades in time
And I never saw you coming
And I'll never be the same
**Love is a ruthless game unless you play it good and right**
These are the hands of fate, **you're my Achilles heel**

tracks.title: Red (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
Loving him is like driving a new Maserati down a dead-end street
Faster than the wind, passionate as sin, ended so suddenly
**Losing him was blue like I'd never known**
Missing him was dark gray, all alone
Forgetting him was like trying to know somebody you never met
But **loving him was red**
Burning red
**Regretting him was like wishing you never found out that love could be that strong**

tracks.title: Treacherous (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
Put your lips close to mine as long as they don't touch
Out of focus, eye to eye, till the gravity's too much
**And I'll do anything you say if you say it with your hands**
And I'd be smart to walk away, but you're quicksand
**This slope is treacherous, I like it**
I can't decide if it's a choice, getting swept away
**I hear the sound of my own voice asking you to stay**

tracks.title: I Knew You Were Trouble (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
Once upon a time, a few mistakes ago
I was in your sights, you got me alone
You found me, you found me, you found me
**I guess you didn't care, and I guess I liked that**
And when I fell hard, you took a step back
**I knew you were trouble when you walked in**
So shame on me now
Flew me to places I'd never been
**Now I'm lying on the cold hard ground**

tracks.title: All Too Well (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
I walked through the door with you, the air was cold
But something about it felt like home somehow
And **I left my scarf there at your sister's house**
And you've still got it in your drawer even now
**Autumn leaves falling down like pieces into place**
And I can picture it after all these days
**And I know it's long gone and that magic's not here no more**
And I might be okay but I'm not fine at all
**'Cause there we are again on that little town street**

tracks.title: 22 (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
It feels like a perfect night to dress up like hipsters
And make fun of our exes, uh-uh, uh-uh
It feels like a perfect night for breakfast at midnight
To fall in love with strangers, uh-uh, uh-uh
**Yeah, we're happy, free, confused, and lonely at the same time**
It's miserable and magical, oh, yeah
**Tonight's the night when we forget about the deadlines**
I don't know about you, but **I'm feeling 22**

tracks.title: I Almost Do (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
I bet this time of night you're still up
I bet you're tired from a long week
I bet you're sitting in your chair by the window looking out at the city
**And I hope sometimes you wonder about me**
And I confess, babe, in my dreams you're touching my cheek
**And saying softly, if I knew what I know now**
I can't say hello to you and risk another goodbye
**And I just wanna tell you, it takes everything in me not to call you**

tracks.title: We Are Never Ever Getting Back Together (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
I remember when we broke up, the first time
Saying, "This is it, I've had enough"
'Cause like we hadn't seen each other in a month
When you said you needed space (What?)
**Then you come around again and say "Baby, I miss you and I swear I'm gonna change"**
Remember? How that lasted for a day?
**You go talk to your friends, talk to my friends, talk to me**
But we are never, ever, ever, ever getting back together

short.es: Reinvención pop total: synth-pop ochentero, hits masivos y una estética de “renacer”.
short.en: Full pop reinvention: ’80s-inspired synth-pop, massive hits, and a ‘rebirth’ aesthetic.

extended.es: Diseñado como un cambio de era, el álbum apuesta por producción brillante, baterías programadas y capas de sintetizadores. Las letras miran el amor y la fama con nostalgia y autoconciencia, mientras el enfoque sonoro consolida su salto definitivo al pop contemporáneo.
extended.en: Conceived as an era shift, it leans on glossy production, programmed drums, and dense synth layers. The writing views love and fame with nostalgia and self-awareness, while the sound cements her definitive leap into modern pop.

tracks.title: Welcome to New York (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
Walking through a crowd, the village is glowin'
Just apart of the scene, her name is on the billboard
**And its burning bright**
Everybody here wanted somethin' more
Searching for a sound we hadn't heard before
**And it said, "Welcome to New York, it's been waiting for you"**
It's a new soundtrack, I could dance to this beat, beat forevermore
**The lights are so bright, but they never blind me**

tracks.title: Blank Space (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
Nice to meet you, where you been?
I could show you incredible things
**Magic, madness, heaven, sin**
Saw you there and I thought, "Oh, my God, look at that face"
You look like my next mistake
**Love's a game, wanna play?**
So it's gonna be forever, or it's gonna go down in flames
You can tell me when it's over, if the high was worth the pain
**Got a long list of ex-lovers, they'll tell you I'm insane**
But I've got a blank space, baby, and I'll write your name

tracks.title: Style (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
Midnight, you come and pick me up, no headlights
Long drive, could end in burning flames or paradise
Fade into view, oh, it's been a while since I even heard from you
**And I should just tell you to leave 'cause I know exactly where it leads**
But I watch us go 'round and 'round each time
**You got that James Dean daydream look in your eye**
And I got that red lip classic thing that you like
**We never go out of style**

tracks.title: Out of the Woods (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
Looking at it now, it all seems so simple
We were lying on your couch, I remember
**You took a Polaroid of us**
Then discovered (then discovered) that the rest of the world was black and white
**But we were in screaming color**
Are we out of the woods yet? Are we out of the woods yet?
**Are we in the clear yet? In the clear yet? Good.**
Remember when you hit the brakes too soon?
Twenty stitches in a hospital room

tracks.title: All You Had to Do Was Stay (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
People like you always want back the love they gave away
And people like me wanna believe you when you say you've changed
**The more I think about it now, the less I know**
All I know is that you drove us off the road
**Stay! Hey, all you had to do was stay**
Had me in the palm of your hand
Then why'd you have to go and lock me out when I let you in?
**Now you say you want it back**

tracks.title: Shake It Off (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
I stay out too late, got nothing in my brain
That's what people say, mm-mm, that's what people say, mm-mm
**I go on too many dates, but I can't make them stay**
At least that's what people say, mm-mm
But I keep cruising, can't stop, won't stop moving
**It's like I got this music in my mind saying, "It's gonna be alright"**
'Cause the players gonna play, play, play, play, play
And the haters gonna hate, hate, hate, hate, hate
**Baby, I'm just gonna shake, shake, shake, shake, shake**

tracks.title: Bad Blood (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
Cause, baby, now we've got bad blood
You know it used to be mad love
**So take a look what you've done**
'Cause, baby, now we've got bad blood, hey!
**Now we've got problems and I don't think we can solve 'em**
You made a really deep cut
And, baby, now we've got bad blood, hey!
**Did you think we'd be fine? Still got scars on my back from your knife**

tracks.title: Wildest Dreams (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
He said, "Let's get out of this town
Drive out of the city, away from the crowds"
**I thought heaven can't help me now**
Nothing lasts forever, but this is gonna take me down
**He's so tall and handsome as hell**
He's so bad, but he does it so well
Say you'll remember me standing in a nice dress
**Staring at the sunset, babe**
Red lips and rosy cheeks, say you'll see me again
Even if it's just in your **wildest dreams**

short.es: Pop oscuro y confrontativo, con narrativa de caída mediática y reconstrucción personal.
short.en: Dark, confrontational pop shaped by media backlash and personal reconstruction.

extended.es: El disco trabaja la dualidad entre imagen pública y vida privada, con una producción más pesada y un tono más irónico. Entre la tensión y la vulnerabilidad, propone una respuesta estética al escrutinio: dramatiza la polémica, pero también abre espacio para el romance y la intimidad.
extended.en: The record explores the split between public persona and private life through heavier production and a sharper, more ironic tone. It turns scrutiny into aesthetic drama, while still carving out space for romance and intimacy.

tracks.title: ...Ready for It?
tracks.lyrics:
Knew he was a killer first time that I saw him
Wondered how many girls he had loved and left haunted
But if he's a ghost, then I can be a phantom
**Holdin' him for ransom, some, some**
In the middle of the night, in my dreams
**You should see the things we do, baby**
I'm so-so-so-so-so-so-so-so-so-so-so-so-so-so-so-so
**Baby, let the games begin**

tracks.title: End Game (feat. Ed Sheeran & Future)
tracks.lyrics:
I wanna be your endgame
I wanna be your first string
**I wanna be your A-Team**
I wanna be your endgame, endgame
**Big reputation, big reputation**
Ooh, you and me, we got big reputations
Ah, and you heard about me
**Oh, I got some big enemies**
I don't wanna touch you, I don't wanna be
Just another ex-love you don't wanna see

tracks.title: I Did Something Bad
tracks.lyrics:
I never trust a narcissist, but they love me
So I play 'em like a violin
And I make it look oh-so-easy
**'Cause for every lie I tell them, they tell me three**
They say I did something bad
Then why's it feel so good?
**Most fun I ever had**
And I'd do it over and over and over again if I could
**They're burning all the witches, even if you aren't one**

tracks.title: Don't Blame Me
tracks.lyrics:
Don't blame me, love made me crazy
If it doesn't, you ain't doin' it right
**Lord, save me, my drug is my baby**
I'll be usin' for the rest of my life
I've been breakin' hearts a long time, and
Toyin' with them older guys
**Just playthings for me to use**
Something happened for the first time
In the darkest little paradise
**Shaking, pacing, I just need you**

tracks.title: Delicate
tracks.lyrics:
This ain't for the best
**My reputation's never been worse, so**
You must like me for me
We can't make any promises now, can we, babe?
But you can make me a drink
**Is it cool that I said all that?**
Is it chill that you're in my head?
**'Cause I know that it's delicate**
Isn't it? Isn't it? Isn't it?

tracks.title: Look What You Made Me Do
tracks.lyrics:
I don't like your little games
Don't like your tilted stage
The role you made me play of the fool
No, I don't like you
**But I got smarter, I got harder in the nick of time**
Honey, I rose up from the dead, I do it all the time
**I'm sorry, the old Taylor can't come to the phone right now**
Why? Oh, 'cause **she's dead!**
Look what you made me do

tracks.title: So It Goes...
tracks.lyrics:
See you in the dark, all eyes on you, my magician
All eyes on us, you make everyone disappear
And **cut me into pieces**
Gold cage, hostage to my feelings
**And you know I'm not a bad girl, but I'd do bad things with you**
So it goes
**Scratches down your back now**
1, 2, 3... and so it goes

tracks.title: Gorgeous
tracks.lyrics:
You should take it as a compliment
That I'm talking to everyone here but you
**And you should think about the consequence**
Of you touching my hand in the darkened room
**You're so gorgeous**
I can't say anything to your face
**'Cause look at your face**
And I'm so furious
At you for making me feel this way
But what can I say? You're gorgeous

short.es: Pop luminoso y romántico, con mirada más amplia sobre amor, ansiedad y pertenencia.
short.en: Bright, romantic pop with a wider lens on love, anxiety, and belonging.

extended.es: Tras un período más sombrío, vuelve a una paleta cálida y colorida. El álbum mezcla himnos pop con momentos más íntimos, y se permite temas de madurez emocional: compromisos, dudas, reconciliaciones y una sensación de hogar.
extended.en: After a darker chapter, it returns with a warm, colorful palette. The album blends pop anthems with more intimate moments, leaning into emotional maturity—commitment, uncertainty, reconciliation, and a sense of home.

tracks.title: I Forgot That You Existed
tracks.lyrics:
How many days did I spend thinking
'Bout how you did me wrong, wrong, wrong?
Lived in the shade you were throwing
**'Til all of my sunshine was gone, gone, gone**
And I couldn't get away from you
In my feelings more than Drake, so true
**And then it was in one magical moment**
It wasn't love, it wasn't hate
**It was just indifference**

tracks.title: Cruel Summer
tracks.lyrics:
Fever dream high in the quiet of the night
You know that I caught it
**Bad, bad boy, shiny toy with a price**
You know that I bought it
Killing me slow, out the window
**I'm always waiting for you to be waiting below**
And it's new, the shape of your body
It's blue, the feeling I've got
**And it's a cruel summer with you**

tracks.title: Lover
tracks.lyrics:
We could leave the Christmas lights up 'til January
And this is our place, we make the rules
**There's a dazzling haze, a mysterious way about you dear**
Have I known you twenty seconds or twenty years?
**Can I go where you go?**
Can we always be this close forever and ever?
And ah, take me out, and take me home
**You're my, my, my, my... lover**

tracks.title: The Man
tracks.lyrics:
I would be complex, I would be cool
They'd say I played the field before I found someone to commit to
And that would be okay for me to do
**Every conquest I had made would make me more of a boss to you**
I'm so sick of running as fast as I can
**Wondering if I'd get there quicker if I was a man**
And I'm so sick of them coming at me again
**'Cause if I was a man, then I'd be the man**

tracks.title: The Archer
tracks.lyrics:
Combat, I'm ready for combat
I say I don't want that, but what if I do?
**'Cause cruelty wins in the movies**
I've got a hundred thrown-out speeches I almost said to you
Easy they come, easy they go
**I jump from the train, I ride off the terrace**
I never grew up, it's getting so old
**Help me hold onto you**

tracks.title: I Think He Knows
tracks.lyrics:
I think he knows
His footprints on the sidewalk
Lead to where I can't stop go-go-going
**He's so gentleman, he don't keep me waiting**
Lyrical smile, indigo eyes, hand on my thigh
**We can follow the sparks, I'll drive**
Loping across the floor
**Can't look at anything else now**

tracks.title: Miss Americana & The Heartbreak Prince
tracks.lyrics:
You know I adore you, I'm caving in
I'll be summer thing for twenty-seven summers
**'Cause I only bought this dress so you could take it off**
It's you and me, that's my whole world
They whisper in the hallway, "She's a bad, bad girl"
**My team is losing, battered and bruising**
I see the high fives between the bad guys
**It's a rom-com waitin' to happen**

tracks.title: Paper Rings
tracks.lyrics:
The moon is high like your friends were the night that we first met
Went home and tried to stalk you on the internet
**Now I've read all of the books beside your bed**
I like shiny things, but I'd marry you with paper rings
**Uh-huh, that's right, darling, you're the one I want**
And I hate accidents except when we went from friends to this
**Wrap your arms around me, baby boy**

tracks.title: Cornelia Street
tracks.lyrics:
We were in the backseat, drunk on something stronger than the drinks in the bar
"I rent a place on Cornelia Street," I say casually in the car
**We were a fresh page on the desk, filling in the blanks as we went**
And I hope I never lose you, hope it never ends
**I'd never walk Cornelia Street again**
That's the kind of heartbreak time could never mend
**I'd never walk Cornelia Street again**

short.es: Giro indie-folk introspectivo, minimalista y narrativo, con personajes y viñetas emocionales.
short.en: An introspective indie-folk pivot—minimal, narrative-driven, and full of character vignettes.

extended.es: Con producción sobria y atmósferas de madera y niebla, el disco prioriza la escritura y la construcción de escenas. Alterna autobiografía con ficción, y apuesta por melodías contenidas que amplifican los matices: duelo, memoria, arrepentimiento y ternura.
extended.en: With restrained production and misty, wood-grain atmospheres, the album foregrounds writing and scene-building. It blends autobiography and fiction, using understated melodies to highlight nuance—grief, memory, regret, and tenderness.

tracks.title: the 1
tracks.lyrics:
I'm doing good, I'm on some new shit
Been saying "yes" instead of "no"
I thought I saw you at the bus stop, I didn't though
**But we were something, don't you think so?**
Roaring twenties, tossing pennies in the pool
**And if my wishes came true, it would've been you**
In my defense, I have none
For never leaving well enough alone
**But it would've been fun if you would've been the one**

tracks.title: cardigan
tracks.lyrics:
Vintage tee, brand new phone
High heels on cobblestones
When you are young, they assume you know nothing
**But I knew you**
Dancin' in your Levi's, drunk under a streetlight
**And when I felt like I was an old cardigan under someone's bed**
You put me on and said I was your favorite
**To kiss in cars and downtown bars was all we needed**

tracks.title: the last great american dynasty
tracks.lyrics:
Rebekah rode up on the afternoon train, it was sunny
Her saltbox house on the coast took her mind off St. Louis
**Bill was the heir to the Standard Oil name and money**
And the town said, "How did a middle-class divorcée do it?"
There goes the last great American dynasty
**Who knows, if she never showed up, what could've been**
Fifty years is a long time
**Holiday House sat quiet on that beach**
Free of women with madness, their men and bad habits

tracks.title: exile (feat. Bon Iver)
tracks.lyrics:
I can see you standing, honey
With his arms around your body
Laughin', but the joke's not funny at all
**I think I've seen this film before and I didn't like the ending**
You're not my homeland anymore
So what am I defending now?
**You were my town, now I'm in exile, seein' you out**
I can see you starin', honey
Like he's just your understudy
**Like you'd get your knuckles bloody for me**

tracks.title: my tears ricochet
tracks.lyrics:
We gather here, we line up, weepin' in a sunlit room
And if I'm on fire, you'll be made of ashes too
**Even on my worst day, did I deserve, babe, all the hell you gave me?**
'Cause I loved you, I swear I loved you 'til my dying day
**I didn't have it in myself to go with grace**
And so the battleships will sink beneath the waves
You had to kill me, but it killed you just the same
**You turned into your worst fears**
And you're tossing out blame, drunk on this pain

tracks.title: mirrorball
tracks.lyrics:
I want you to know I'm a mirrorball
**I'll show you every version of yourself tonight**
I'll get you out on the floor
Shimmering beautiful
**And when I break, it's in a million pieces**
Hush, I know they said the end is near
**But I'm still on my tallest tiptoes**
Spinning in my highest heels, love
Shining just for you

tracks.title: seven
tracks.lyrics:
Please picture me in the trees
I hit my peak at seven feet
**In the weeds before I learned civility**
I used to scream ferociously any time I wanted
**Please picture me in the weeds before I learned civility**
I think your house is haunted
Your dad is always mad and that must be why
**And I think you should come live with me**
And we can be pirates

tracks.title: august
tracks.lyrics:
Salt air, and the rust on your door
I never needed anything more
**Whispers of "Are you sure?" "Never have I ever before"**
But I can see us lost in the memory
August sipped away like a bottle of wine
**'Cause you were never mine**
Your back beneath the sun
Wishin' I could write my name on it
**Will you call when you're back at school?**
I remember thinkin' I had you

short.es: Compañero “invernal” de folklore: más narrativo, más rústico, y con giros de humor y melancolía.
short.en: A ‘wintery’ companion to folklore—more narrative, more rustic, with turns of humor and melancholy.

extended.es: Profundiza el enfoque de relatos y climas acústicos, sumando arreglos que oscilan entre lo íntimo y lo cinematográfico. Las canciones exploran la pérdida, los finales inevitables y la resiliencia, con una voz compositiva que se siente más libre y experimental en los bordes.
extended.en: It deepens the story-first approach and acoustic mood, adding arrangements that shift from intimate to cinematic. The songs explore loss, inevitable endings, and resilience, with a songwriting voice that feels freer and more edge-experimental.

tracks.title: willow
tracks.lyrics:
I'm like an eight-foot-wide ocean, say you'll jump in
And follow the cut on your nose, that's where I'll begin
**I'm like the water when your ship rolled in that night**
Rough on the surface but you cut through like a knife
And if it was an open-and-shut case
**I never would've known from that look on your face**
Lost in your current like a priceless wine
**Wait for the signal and I'll meet you every time**

tracks.title: champagne problems
tracks.lyrics:
You booked the night train for a reason
So you could sit there in this hurt
**Bustling crowds or silent sleepers**
You're not sure which is worse
Your Midas touch on the Chevy door
**November flush and your flannel cure**
"This dorm was once a madhouse"
I made a joke, "Well, it's made for me"
**She would've made such a lovely bride**
What a shame she's fucked in the head

tracks.title: gold rush
tracks.lyrics:
Gleaming, twinkling
Eyes like sinking ships on waters
So inviting, I almost jump in
**But I don't like a gold rush, gold rush**
I don't like anticipating my face in a red flush
**I don't like that anyone would die to feel your touch**
Everybody wants you, everybody wonders what it would be like to love you
**Walk past, quick brush**
I don't like a gold rush

tracks.title: 'tis the damn season
tracks.lyrics:
If I wanted to know who you were hanging with
We could've stayed lookin' at the stars for a while
**You could've helped me forget that I was a child**
But the school year's coming and the weather's cold
**And it's the damn season, write this down**
I'm staying at my parents' house
And the road not taken looks real good now
**And it always leads to you in my hometown**

tracks.title: tolerate it
tracks.lyrics:
I sit and watch you reading with your head low
I wake and bake the garden in the winter snow
**I tell you my dreams and you think I'm telling a joke**
I'm a kid in a corner, she's a tiger in a cage
**If it's all in my head, tell me now**
Tell me I've got it wrong somehow
**I know my love should be celebrated**
But you tolerate it
I made you my temple, my mural, my sky

tracks.title: no body, no crime (feat. HAIM)
tracks.lyrics:
He did it, he did it
Estee's a friend of mine
**She's been losing sleep, she said her husband's acting different**
And it smells like infidelity and bad decisions
**He reports his missing wife and I get the feeling he's lying**
I think he did it, but I just can't prove it
**No body, no crime**
But I ain't letting up until the day I die
**I wasn't letting it go**

tracks.title: happiness
tracks.lyrics:
Honey, when I'm above the trees
I see this for what it is
**But now I'm right down in it, all the years I've given**
Is just shit we're dividing up
**There'll be happiness after you**
But there was happiness because of you too
**No one teaches you what to do**
When a good man hurts you
And you know you hurt him too

tracks.title: dorothea
tracks.lyrics:
Hey, Dorothea, do you ever stop and think about me?
When we were younger down in the park
**Honey, making a lark of the misery**
You got shiny friends since you left town
**A tiny screen's the only place I see you now**
And I got nothing but well wishes for ya
**Ooh, this place is the same as it ever was**
But you don't like it that way

short.es: Pop nocturno y confesional: insomnio, recuerdos y autoexamen con brillo electrónico.
short.en: Confessional nighttime pop: insomnia, memories, and self-examination with electronic sheen.

extended.es: El álbum se construye como una serie de “noches” y pensamientos recurrentes: decisiones pasadas, inseguridades y deseos. La producción prioriza texturas sintéticas y ganchos precisos, combinando introspección lírica con un pulso pop constante.
extended.en: Built as a set of ‘midnight’ reflections, it circles past choices, insecurities, and desires. The production favors synthetic textures and tight hooks, pairing lyrical introspection with a steady pop drive.

tracks.title: Lavender Haze
tracks.lyrics:
Meet me at midnight...
Staring at the ceiling with you
Oh, you don't ever say too much
**And you don't really read into my melancholia**
I've been under scrutiny (Yeah, oh, yeah)
You handle it beautifully (Yeah, oh, yeah)
**All they keep asking me is if I'm gonna be your bride**
The only kind of girl they see is a one-night or a wife
**I'm damned if I do give a damn what people say**
No deal, the 1950s shit they want from me
I just wanna stay in that **lavender haze**

tracks.title: Maroon
tracks.lyrics:
When the morning came we were cleaned of incense
Your vinyl shelf with the shoulder pads we left on the floor
**Laughing with my feet in your lap**
Like you were my closest friend
**"How'd we get here?" so scan and skip**
And I'll be your girl on the back of the ship
And I wake with your memory over me
**That's a real fucking legacy, legacy (to leave)**
And I lost you, the one I was loving
**The burgundy on my t-shirt when you splashed your wine into me**
And how the blood rushed into my cheeks, so scarlet, it was **maroon**

tracks.title: Anti-Hero
tracks.lyrics:
I have this thing where I get older but just never wiser
Midnights become my afternoons
**When my depression works the graveyard shift**
All of the people I've ghosted stand there in the room
**I should not be left to my own devices**
They come with prices and vices
I end up in crisis (Tale as old as time)
**It's me, hi, I'm the problem, it's me**
At tea time, everybody agrees
**I'll stare directly at the sun but never in the mirror**
It must be exhausting always rooting for the anti-hero

tracks.title: Snow On The Beach (feat. Lana Del Rey)
tracks.lyrics:
One night, a few moons ago
I saw flecks of what could've been lights
But it might just have been you
**Passing by, unbeknownst to me**
Life is emotionally abusive
And dying can be a remedy
**And it's coming down, it's coming down**
It's like snow on the beach
**Weird but fucking beautiful**
Flying in a dream, stars by the pocketful
**You wanting me tonight feels impossible**

tracks.title: You're On Your Own, Kid
tracks.lyrics:
Summer went away, still the yearning stays
I play it cool with the best of them
**I wait patiently, he's gonna notice me**
It's okay, we're the best of friends, anyway
I search the party of better bodies
**Just to learn that you never cared**
From sprinkler splashes to fireplace ashes
**I gave my blood, sweat, and tears for this**
Everything you lose is a step you take
**So make the friendship bracelets, take the moment and taste it**
**You're on your own, kid, you always have been**

tracks.title: Midnight Rain
tracks.lyrics:
Rain, he wanted it comfortable, I wanted that pain
He wanted a bride, I was making my own name
**Chasing that fame, he stayed the same**
All of me changed like midnight
**My boy was a montage, a slow-motion, double-vision in rose blush**
I broke his heart 'cause he was nice
**He was sunshine, I was midnight rain**
He wanted it comfortable, I wanted that pain
**I guess sometimes we all get just what we wanted**

tracks.title: Question...?
tracks.lyrics:
I remember... good girl, sad boy
Big city, wrong choices
**We had one thing going for us, it was one thing out of the way**
Can I ask you a question?
**Did you ever have someone kiss you in a crowded room?**
And every single one of your friends was making fun of you
But fifteen seconds later they were clapping too?
**Then did you leave her house in the middle of the night?**
Do you wish you could still touch her?
**It's just a question**

tracks.title: Bejeweled
tracks.lyrics:
Baby love, I think I've been a little too kind
**Didn't notice you walking all over my peace of mind**
In the shoes I gave you as a present
Putting someone first only works when you're in their top five
**And by the way, I'm going out tonight**
Best believe I'm still bejeweled
**When I walk in the room, I can still make the whole place shimmer**
And don't put me in the basement
When I want the penthouse of your heart
**I polish up real nice**

short.es: Pop literario y catártico: un diario emocional con estética de blanco y negro y dramatismo elegante.
short.en: Literary, cathartic pop: an emotional journal with monochrome aesthetics and elegant drama.

extended.es: El disco enfatiza la escritura como escena: referencias, confesiones y tensión narrativa sostenida. Entre melodías melancólicas y momentos de energía, se siente como un cuaderno abierto que alterna ironía y vulnerabilidad, con foco en las consecuencias emocionales de relaciones y exposición pública.
extended.en: The album foregrounds writing as scene—references, confessions, and sustained narrative tension. Across melancholic melodies and sharper bursts, it reads like an open notebook toggling irony and vulnerability, focused on the emotional fallout of relationships and public exposure.

tracks.title: Fortnight (feat. Post Malone)
tracks.lyrics:
I was supposed to be sent away but they forgot to come and get me
I was a tame escapee, settling down near where you live
**And I love you, it's ruining my life**
I touched you for only a fortnight
**I touched you, but I touched you**
Your wife buys flowers, I wanna kill her
**All my mornings are Mondays stuck in an endless February**
I took the miracle move-on drug, the effects were temporary
**And I love you, it's ruining my life**

tracks.title: The Tortured Poets Department
tracks.lyrics:
You left your typewriter at my apartment
Straight from the Tortured Poets Department
**I think some things I never say**
"Like who uses typewriters anyway?"
But you're in self-sabotage mode, throwing spikes on the road
**But you told Lucy you'd kill yourself if I ever leave**
And I had said that to Jack about you, so I felt seen
**You're not Dylan Thomas, I'm not Patti Smith**
This ain't the Chelsea Hotel, **we're modern idiots**

tracks.title: My Boy Only Breaks His Favorite Toys
tracks.lyrics:
Oh, here we go again
The voices in his head called the rain to end our days of wild abandon
**I felt more when we played pretend than with all the others**
I'm queen of sandcastles he destroys
**'Cause it fits his hands like a glove, oh, oh**
My boy only breaks his favorite toys, toys, oh
**I'm pullin' the string and he's not saying anything**
I saw revamped, repurposed, tell me I'm your favorite

tracks.title: Down Bad
tracks.lyrics:
Did you really beam me up? In a cloud of sparkling dust
Just to do experiments on me and leave me in the barrens of my night?
**Now I'm down bad, crying at the gym**
Everything comes out teenage petulance
**"Fuck it if I can't have him"**
I might just die, it would make no difference
**Down bad, waking up in blood**
Staring at the sky, come back and pick me up
**Like I'm a victim of an encounter that I can't explain**

tracks.title: So Long, London
tracks.lyrics:
I saw in my mind ferry lights through the mist
I kept calm and carried the weight of the rift
**Pulled him in tighter each time he was drifting away**
My spine split from carrying us up the hill
**And you say I abandoned the ship, but I was going down with it**
So long, London
**You'll find someone**
I'm just mad as hell 'cause I loved this place for
**So long, London, had a good run**
A moment of warm sun, but I'm not the one

tracks.title: But Daddy I Love Him
tracks.lyrics:
I'm having his baby... No, I'm not, but you should see your faces
I'm telling you that my mind is made up, far from the crowd
**The judgmental creeps who think they want what's best for me**
Stay away from my wild boy and all this wild joy
**God save the most judgmental creeps**
Who say they want what's best for me
**I'll tell you something 'bout my good name**
It's mine alone to disgrace
**I don't cater to all these vipers dressed in empath's clothing**

tracks.title: Florida!!! (feat. Florence + The Machine)
tracks.lyrics:
You can beat it, baby, you can beat it
**The hurricane with my name coming in from the coast**
And the town that we're in is just a ghost
**Florida!!! Is a hell of a drug**
Florida!!! Can I use you up?
**Little did you know, my hometown was a graveyard**
So I'm packing my bags and I'm heading for the sun
**I need a new place to be someone**

tracks.title: Who's Afraid of Little Old Me?
tracks.lyrics:
I was tame, I was gentle till the circus life made me mean
**"Don't put him in the cage" you screamed**
But I was the one who was bleeding
**Who's afraid of little old me?**
You should be
**You caged me and then you called me crazy**
I am what I am 'cause you trained me
**So tell me, who's afraid of little old me?**
I'll sue you if you step on my lawn
I'm a levitating vessel that should've been gone

short.es: Regrabación que recontextualiza Fearless con voz madura y material “vault” que amplía la era.
short.en: A re-recording that reframes Fearless with a mature voice and vault tracks that expand the era.

extended.es: Mantiene la esencia del original pero con interpretación más asentada y detalles de producción ajustados. Las canciones inéditas (“vault”) funcionan como piezas faltantes: complementan el relato juvenil con perspectiva adulta y completan el mapa emocional de esa etapa.
extended.en: It preserves the original’s spirit with a more settled performance and subtle production refinements. The vault tracks act like missing chapters, complementing youthful narratives with adult perspective and rounding out the era’s emotional map.

tracks.title: The Best Day (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
I'm five years old, it's getting cold, I've got my big coat on
I hear your laugh and look up smiling at you, I run and run
**Past the pumpkin patch and the tractor rides**
Look now, the sky is gold
**I know you were on my side even when I was wrong**
And I love you for giving me your eyes
For staying back and watching me shine and
**I didn't know if you knew, so I'm taking this chance to say**
That I had the best day with you today

tracks.title: Change (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
And it's a sad picture, the final blow hits you
Somebody else gets what you wanted again
**You know it's all the same, another time and place**
Repeating history and you're getting sick of it
**But these walls that they put up to hold us back will fall down**
This revolution, the time will come for us to finally win
**And we'll sing hallelujah, things will change**
Can you feel it now? These walls that they put up to hold us back will fall down

tracks.title: You All Over Me (feat. Maren Morris) (From The Vault)
tracks.lyrics:
Once the last drop of rain has dried off the pavement
Shouldn't I find a stain, but I never do
**The way the tires spin on a blacktop road**
I thought it was over now, but I guess it never is
**No amount of freedom gets you clean**
I've still got you all over me
**The best and worst day of June was the one that I met you**
With your hands in your pockets and your 'don't you wish you had me' grin

tracks.title: Mr. Perfectly Fine (From The Vault)
tracks.lyrics:
Mr. "Perfect face", Mr. "Here to stay"
Mr. "Looked me in the eye and told me you would never go away"
**Hello, Mr. "Perfectly fine"**
How's your heart after breaking mine?
**Mr. "Always at the right place at the right time," baby**
Goodbye, Mr. "Casually cruel"
Mr. "Everything revolves around you"
**I've been Miss "Misery" since your goodbye**
And you're Mr. "Perfectly fine"

tracks.title: That's When (feat. Keith Urban) (From The Vault)
tracks.lyrics:
You said, "I know I said I'm sorry, can we just go back to the start?"
I said, "I need a little time just to think about my heart"
**And that's when, when I wake up in the morning**
That's when, when it's sunny or it's storming
**Laughing when I'm crying, and that's when I'll be waiting at the front gate**
That's when, when I'm reaching for your hand
**And I can't feel you there, that's when I miss you**
That's when I want you back

tracks.title: Don't You (From The Vault)
tracks.lyrics:
Hey, I knew I'd run into you somewhere
It's been a while, I didn't think you'd care
**But don't you smile at me and ask me how I've been**
Don't you say you've missed me if you don't want me again
**You don't know how much I feel I'm burning up inside**
And you're just passing by, well, **don't you**
So give me a reason and I'll give you a goodbye

tracks.title: Bye Bye Baby (From The Vault)
tracks.lyrics:
It wasn't just like a movie, the rain didn't soak through my clothes down to my bones
I'm not a princess, this ain't a fairy tale
**And you're not the one who'll sweep me off my feet**
Lead me up the stairwell
**Bye, bye, to everything I thought was on my side**
Bye, bye, baby
**I want you back but it's come down to nothing**
And all I have is your picture in my frame

short.es: Regrabación expansiva: vuelve a Red con más claridad vocal y foco en el arco narrativo (y sus “vaults”).
short.en: An expansive revisit: clearer vocals, a refreshed arc, and vault tracks that deepen the story.

extended.es: Reafirma el carácter mixtape del original, pero con una lectura más controlada y detallada. Las pistas inéditas amplían la paleta emocional y estilística, reforzando el lugar del álbum como bisagra entre country-pop y pop total, ahora narrado desde la distancia del tiempo.
extended.en: It reasserts the original’s mixtape nature with a more controlled, detailed read. Vault tracks broaden the emotional and stylistic palette, strengthening the album’s role as a bridge toward full pop—now narrated with time’s distance.

short.es: Regrabación de su álbum más “autor” (escrito por ella), con lectura vocal más madura y nuevas piezas vault.
short.en: A re-recording of her most self-authored album (entirely written by her), with a more mature vocal read and new vault tracks.

extended.es: La regrabación conserva el dramatismo y el pulso pop-rock, pero con un timbre más pleno y un enfoque interpretativo más calmo. Las canciones “vault” suman contexto a la etapa y amplían el rango emocional sin romper la cohesión del disco original.
extended.en: It keeps the drama and pop-rock pulse, but with fuller vocals and a calmer interpretive stance. Vault tracks add context to the era and widen the emotional range without breaking the original album’s cohesion.

tracks.title: Stay Stay Stay (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
I'm pretty sure we almost broke up last night
I threw my phone across the room at you
**I was expecting some dramatic turn-away**
But you stayed
**You think that it's funny when I'm mad, mad, mad**
But I think that it's best if we both stay
**Before you, I'd only dated self-indulgent takers**
Who took all of their problems out on me
But you carry my groceries and now I'm always laughing

tracks.title: The Last Time (feat. Gary Lightbody) (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
I find myself at your door just like all those times before
I'm not sure how I got there, all roads they lead me here
**I imagine you are home, in your slippers, by the stove**
You tell me that you're sorry, have you said these words before?
**And this is the last time I'm asking you why**
You break my heart in the blink of an eye
**You find yourself at my door, just like all those times before**
You wear your best apology, but I was there to watch you leave

tracks.title: Holy Ground (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
I was reminiscing just the other day
While having coffee all alone and Lord, it took me away
**Back to a first-glance feeling on New York Time**
Back to when you fit my poems like a perfect rhyme
**And I guess we fell apart in the usual way**
And the story's got dust on every page
**But sometimes I wonder how you think about it now**
And I see your face in every crowd
'Cause darling, it was **holy ground**

tracks.title: Begin Again (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
Took a deep breath in the mirror
He didn't like it when I wore high heels, but I do
**Turned the lock and put my headphones on**
He always said he didn't get this song but I do, I do
**And you threw your head back laughing like a little kid**
It's the first time you've ever seen me look like this
**And for the first time, what's past is past**
I've spent the last eight months thinking all love ever does is break and burn and end
But on a Wednesday in a cafe, **I watched it begin again**

tracks.title: Nothing New (feat. Phoebe Bridgers) (From The Vault)
tracks.lyrics:
They tell you while you're young, "Girls, go out and have your fun"
Then they hunt and slay the ones who actually do it
**I've had (I've had) too much to drink tonight**
And I know it's sad, but this is what it's like
**How can a person know everything at eighteen but nothing at twenty-two?**
And will you still want me when I'm nothing new?
**How long will it be cute, all this crying in my room?**
When you can't blame it on my youth and roll your eyes with affection

tracks.title: I Bet You Think About Me (feat. Chris Stapleton) (From The Vault)
tracks.lyrics:
3 AM and I'm still awake, I'll bet you're just fine
Fast asleep in your city that's better than mine
**And the girl in your bed has a fine pedigree**
And I'll bet your friends tell you she's better than me
**I bet you think about me when you're at your cool indie music concerts every week**
I bet you think about me in your house with your organic shoes and your million-dollar couch
**I bet you think about me when you say "Oh my god, she's insane, she wrote a song about me"**
I bet you think about me

tracks.title: All Too Well (10 Minute Version) (Taylor's Version) (From The Vault)
tracks.lyrics:
And you were tossing me the car keys, "Fuck the patriarchy"
Key chain on the ground, we were always skipping town
**And I was never good at telling jokes, but the punchline goes**
"I'll get older, but your lovers stay my age"
**From when your Brooklyn broke my skin and bones**
I'm a soldier who's returning half her weight
**And did the twin flame bruise paint you blue?**
Just between us, did the love affair maim you too?
**'Cause in this city's barren cold, I still remember the first fall of snow**
And how it glistened as it fell, I remember it **all too well**

short.es: Regrabación de su reinvención pop: brillo synth-pop, voz más firme y vault tracks que completan la era.
short.en: A re-recording of her pop reinvention: synth-pop shine, steadier vocals, and vault tracks that complete the era.

extended.es: Revisita el sonido ochentero con precisión y energía, manteniendo el carácter de hit tras hit. La interpretación más madura cambia matices emocionales de letras ya icónicas, mientras que los “vault” agregan nuevas perspectivas y cierran la narrativa de esa etapa pop.
extended.en: It revisits the ’80s-inspired sound with precision and momentum, keeping the hit-after-hit character intact. A more mature performance shifts the emotional shading of iconic lyrics, while vault tracks add new angles and round out the era’s pop narrative.

short.es: Regreso al pop luminoso con Max Martin y Shellback, en una era más festiva y directa.
short.en: A bright pop return with Max Martin and Shellback, leaning into a more celebratory, straightforward era.

extended.es: Con una producción orientada al pop clásico de estadio y hooks inmediatos, el álbum se apoya en energía, romanticismo y actitud. Funciona como contraste a trabajos más introspectivos, apostando por dinamismo y una estética de espectáculo, con el trío productor como motor sonoro central.
extended.en: Driven by classic stadium-pop instincts and immediate hooks, the album leans into energy, romance, and attitude. It contrasts more introspective work by prioritizing momentum and showmanship, with the producer trio at the sonic center.

tracks.title: How You Get The Girl (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
Stand there like a ghost, shaking from the rain, rain
She'll open up the door and say, "Are you insane?"
**Say it's been a long six months**
And you were too afraid to tell her what you want
**And that's how it works, that's how you get the girl**
Remind her how it used to be
**With pictures in frames of kisses on magical nights**
Tell her how you must've lost your mind

tracks.title: This Love (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
Clear blue water, high tide came and brought you in
And I could go on and on, on and on, and I will
**Skies grew darker, currents swept you out again**
And you were just a ghost at sea
**This love is good, this love is bad**
This love is alive back from the dead, oh, oh
**These hands had to let it go free, and this love came back to me**
Tossed together, kept asleep, and finally exposed

tracks.title: I Know Places (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
You stand with your hand on my waistline
It's a scene and we're out here in plain sight
**I can hear them whisper as we pass by**
It's a bad sign, bad sign
**Something happens when everybody finds out**
See the vultures watching, eagles on a line
**'Cause they got the cages, they got the boxes**
And guns, they are the hunters, we are the foxes
**And we run**

tracks.title: Clean (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
The drought was the very worst, ah, ah
When the flowers that we'd grown together died of thirst
**It was months and months of back and forth**
You're still all over me like a wine-stained dress I can't wear anymore
**Rain came pouring down when I was drowning**
That's when I could finally breathe
**And by morning, gone was any trace of you**
I think I am finally clean

tracks.title: New Romantics (Taylor's Version)
tracks.lyrics:
We're all here, the lights and noise are blinding
We hang back, it's all in the timing
**It's poker, he can't see it in my face**
But I'm about to play my Ace
**Heartbreak is the national anthem, we sing it proudly**
We are too busy dancing to get knocked off our feet
**Baby, we're the new romantics**
The best people in life are free

tracks.title: “Slut!” (Taylor's Version) (From The Vault)
tracks.lyrics:
Flamingo pink, Sunrise Boulevard
Clink, clink, being this young is art
**Aquamarine, moonlit swimming pool**
What if all I need is you?
**But if I'm all dressed up, they might as well be looking at us**
And if they call me a slut
**You know it might be worth it for once**
And if I'm gonna be drunk, might as well be drunk in love

tracks.title: Say Don't Go (Taylor's Version) (From The Vault)
tracks.lyrics:
I'm known as a quiet queen of some small-town city
I'm not used to this, I'm not used to you
**Why'd you have to lead me on? Why'd you have to twist the knife?**
Walk away and leave me in the middle of the night
**I'm holding my breath, won't you say something?**
Say, "Don't go"
**I would stay forever if you say, "Don't go"**
But you're silent and it's killing me

tracks.title: Is It Over Now? (Taylor's Version) (From The Vault)
tracks.lyrics:
Once the flight attendant said, "Keep your seatbelt fastened"
And I thought about how you're still a great person
**Whose new girl is a clone of me**
And did you think I didn't see you? There were flashing lights
**At least I had the decency to keep my nights out of the sight**
Of the photographers, oh Lord
**Was it over when she laid down on your couch?**
Was it over then? And is it over now?
